subject: BlueSure: post-incident communique and accountability lane
messages:
From: Lara Thompson <lara@bluesurebank.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Service errors impacting batch ingest (first notice)

David / Marissa,

We started seeing elevated 500s from your ingestion endpoint (POST /v1/batch/ingest) at ~08:50 PDT. Errors persisted for ~18 minutes and affected ~6% of our hourly job runs. Included a short excerpt of the failure logs we pulled — attaching a fuller sample.

Quick ask: can you confirm whether this was caused by a model rollout or infra event? We need an initial summary for our on-call rotation and a copy of any request IDs tied to failed calls.

Attachment: request-log-samples.txt (text, 8KB)

Thanks,
Lara
Lara Thompson
Head of Platform Reliability
BlueSure Bank

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Lara Thompson <lara@bluesurebank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Service errors impacting batch ingest (acknowledgement)

Thanks for the heads-up, Lara — and sorry for the disruption. We’re investigating now. Initial notes:
- No widespread model rollout was pushed from production at 08:50 PDT.
- Our SREs are looking at routing and autoscaler logs; Mina is pulling KV-cache and host-level traces.
- Please hold on additional mitigation steps until we confirm whether this is an internal capacity/flooding issue or a malformed payload pattern.

We’ll send a concise timeline and request IDs within ~2 hours.

Best,
David Kim
Director, Incident Response
Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Lara Thompson <lara@bluesurebank.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Service errors impacting batch ingest (initial findings)

Hi Lara,

We pulled the traces and correlate the failures to an autoscaler mis-fire in one of the Dedicated pools that caused a short period of transient connection resets and rejected streaming handshakes. High-level timeline:
- 08:49 PDT: load spike on pool-rd-ded-4 (unusual client-side retried batches).
- 08:50–09:08 PDT: autoscaler attempted to scale up but hit a race condition causing TCP connection churn on a subset of nodes.
- 09:09 PDT: fallback routing engaged and traffic routed to another pool; error rate returned to baseline.

Immediate mitigations taken:
- Disabled the autoscaler policy that triggered the mis-fire.
- Forced cache warm-up on replacement hosts to avoid cold-KV misses.
- Collected request IDs and attached a short sample (request-log-samples.txt).

We’re completing a full RCA and will share a customer-facing summary and an action ledger with owners and timelines by end of day.

If you need earlier details for a post-incident brief to your execs, let me know and I’ll prioritize.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Lara Thompson <lara@bluesurebank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: BlueSure post-incident communique and accountability lane

Hi Lara — thank you again for patience while we completed our investigation. Below is a concise, customer-facing postmortem and the committed action ledger. I’ve also attached a compact RCA PDF and a detailed timeline CSV.

Executive summary:
- Impact: Between 08:50–09:08 PDT on 2027-03-18, BlueSure saw intermittent 5xx errors for batch ingest calls (~6% of hourly jobs).
- Root cause: An autoscaler race condition in a Dedicated pool (pool-rd-ded-4) caused ephemeral node restarts and TCP connection resets; this coincided with a concentrated client retry pattern that amplified the effect.
- Scope: The issue affected requests routed to pool-rd-ded-4 only; we detected no data loss and successful retries completed after fallback routing.

Timeline (high level):
- 08:48 PDT: BlueSure scheduled hourly batch run; our telemetry shows an atypical surge of concurrent connections from three BlueSure jobs.
- 08:49 PDT: Pool load exceeded the trigger threshold.
- 08:50 PDT: Autoscaler invoked scale-up; due to a lock-ordering bug the scale actions competed and restarted a subset of hosts causing connection churn.
- 08:59 PDT: Observability detected error spike; automatic fallback routing began to favor alternate pools.
- 09:08–09:10 PDT: Fallback routing fully restored success rates to baseline.

Immediate corrective actions (completed):
1) Reverted the autoscaler policy change and applied a hotfix to prevent the lock-order race (owner: Mina Haddad, completed 2027-03-18).
2) Forced KV-cache warm-up on newly provisioned hosts to reduce cold misses (owner: Marissa Cole, completed 2027-03-18).
3) Added extra tracing around streaming handshakes to capture connection churn patterns (owner: David Kim, completed 2027-03-18).

Committed medium-term mitigations (timeline + owners):
- Autoscaler rewrite & stress testing (owner: Infrastructure team lead — Mina Haddad) — ETA 2027-04-15.
- Client-side retry guidance & SDK patch to stagger retries under backpressure (owner: SDK team — Marissa Cole) — ETA 2027-04-05.
- Route-smoothing policy to avoid concentrated routing to a single Dedicated pool under surge (owner: Network Reliability — David Kim) — ETA 2027-04-01.

Compensation/credits: We recognize this impacted your job SLAs. I’ve opened HubSpot HS-4982 to track the credit request; our billing team will follow up.

Attachments: bluesure-rca-summary.pdf (PDF, 230 KB); bluesure-incident-timeline.csv (CSV, 12KB)

If you’d like a short readout for your CTO, we can schedule a 30-minute slot next week.

Best regards,
David Kim
Director, Incident Response
Redwood Inference

From: Lara Thompson <lara@bluesurebank.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: BlueSure Bank SRE <sre@bluesurebank.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BlueSure post-incident communique and accountability lane

David / team — thanks for the thorough summary and the clear ownership. A few follow-ups from our side:
- We appreciate the SDK retry guidance; can you share an ETA for the patch release channel and a short migration note for our engineers?
- For the credit request, please include the estimated number of failed jobs in HS-4982 so our finance team can reconcile.
- We'll take the readout next Tuesday 10:00 PDT if that works for your team — we can confirm after lunch.

Acknowledged on the completed mitigations.

— Lara
